build: cargo build --release -p clustervision --bin cv; opt-level 3, thin LTO, no probe-heap, jobs 2, exclusive target
methodology: Two synthetic Codex sources: 10,000 alternating user/assistant ordinary messages, and one 16 MiB UTF8 assistant followed by two tiny assistants. Both start with initial-model and end with late-model.
Three alternating transport rounds with separate fresh scratch catalogs and source copies. HTTP extra=true equals extra=1 and matches generated MCP show extra demand.
Startup measured separately without sampling. Request wall, first byte and output use the unmodified production binary. Live process CPU includes child CPU after wait.

Mach usage units calibrated independently against Python process_time; this host uses 125/3 ns per tick. Memory and unlinked vnode lengths sampled every 10 ms are lower bounds, not requested-heap or physical disk occupancy.

A separate binary with an observer-only 23-line patch records parser and authority extents and actual checkpoint use. Observer source changes were restored. Observer timings are excluded. Extents count framed producer records, not all decoder visits or filesystem IO.

oracle: Selected-message semantic SHA matches MCP and HTTP for first, adjacent, repeat and append windows in all three rounds of both controls. Entire budget-1000 CLI stdout equals MCP text byte for byte; CLI stderr continuation is absent from MCP.

wire_differences.mcp: JSON-RPC result.content[0].text contains pretty final Session JSON. Successful child stderr is discarded. The first message may exceed the budget.
wire_differences.http: Compact window envelope includes start/end/has_more/total_known/total/message_count/session/messages. It uses first-pushed metadata and may stop early. The HTTP end=50 control has no equivalent byte budget.

recommendation: Prefer generic staged subprocess output plus streaming JSON-RPC text publication and a separate success-continuation text block. Keep the existing CLI child and tool schemas. Replace full stdout/String clones and the response Vec buffer. Defer broad read-engine unification: final versus partial metadata and checkpoint/append policies differ.
